analyst_view.overall: Sparta (12th, 12 pts) host AZ (5th, 23 pts), who have won only one of their last five league games and travel to Sparta Prague in the Europa League next. AZ coach Leeroy Echteld confirmed on 20 November that Kees Smit, Lewis Schouten and Weslley Patati are not expected back before the winter break, and Jizz Hornkamp (counted) is also set to miss the trip; Valdemar Byskov is back, and Wouter Goes and keeper Owusu-Oduro are 50/50. The numbers count only Hornkamp, Zoet and Resink for AZ, though Smit has been out about six weeks so recent form partly shows it. Sparta lost 3-1 at ADO before the break and miss keeper Michael Brouwer, Teo Quintero and Nick Verschuren, with Julian Baas likely back from illness; the numbers list no Sparta absences. Referee Ingmar Oostrom's slightly above-average card rate is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, already taking about 5% off AZ for Hornkamp and counting Sparta's 16 conceded in six. AZ's extra absences (Smit, Patati, Schouten) weaken their attack, while Sparta are without keeper Brouwer and defenders Quintero and Verschuren, which helps AZ; the two roughly cancel, so I stay at 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.6 corners, with AZ's low corners conceded and Sparta's normal output already counted. Losing wide man Patati could cut AZ's crossing a little, but Byskov's return offsets it, so I stay at 10.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards, already pushed up for Sparta's 14 cards in six (+8%) and for Ingmar Oostrom (3.3 a game). No suspensions or extra needle are reported, so I stay at 3.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots, with AZ's 93 shots in six counted (+8%). AZ are short of attacking depth with Patati, Schouten and the creative Smit all out on top of Hornkamp, confirmed by Echteld, and a European trip follows, so I trim slightly to about 28.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target, already lifted a little for AZ's accuracy (+6%). With fewer attacking options for AZ than the numbers assume, I shade it to about 9.9.
